verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Formant publishes an llms.txt at docs.formant.io/llms.txt, which returned HTTP 200 with real documentation content. Its docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs, so an AI agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents consume these docs well (no OpenAPI spec was found either).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
